data.name: Mithinga
data.gender_notes: Mithinga is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mithila', meaning sweet, delicate, and charming. In Hindu mythology, Mithila is also the name of the sacred land where Lord Rama and Sita got married. The name Mithinga carries the meaning “Sweetness, Delicacy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mithinga usually hope their child will grow to embody sweetness, delicacy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Evokes a sense of inner sweetness, compassion, and grace. Inspires a deep connection with nature and the divine.
data.etymology: Mithinga belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweetness, Delicacy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mithinga total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
